blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday accused the Marcos administration of politically targeting her through the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), dismissing the bureau’s findings on her alleged misdeclared properties as a “shameless smear campaign.” Duterte’s spokesperson, Salvador Paolo A.
